name: Saroma (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Saroma town emblem in white: a broken ring enclosing horizontal bars, forming a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Saroma, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 April 1958; the emblem dates from 1 April 1953.

features.role: Saroma town emblem — a broken ring enclosing horizontal bars, forming a stylised character
